strategy.name: intraday_sma_one_at_a_time_two_period_sensitivity
strategy.description: 固定此前 1999–2014 窗口代表参数作为基线，每次只扰动 A–H、L、R 或强制买回开关中的一个维度，在 1999–2009 与 2010–2026 两个不重叠时期分别观察 CAGR 和 Sharpe 曲线，以判断基线附近的局部平滑性、边界敏感性和跨时期方向一致性。
strategy.buy_rule: 空仓时由 H 日 SMA 上穿、价格上穿 F 三短均线平均值下方 G%，或已启用的卖出价上方 R% 强制买回中任一规则全仓买入。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时 OR：成本价下方 L%；F 三短均线平均变化率连续 A 日为负且价格跌破 B 日 SMA；此前连续 D-1 日三短均线平均变化率为负且当日三条短 SMA 各自变化率均不高于 C%；E 日 SMA 下穿。
strategy.signal_time: 每个交易日开始前只用截至前一交易日 Close 的历史计算条件单；2010 窗口使用此前历史预热指标但预热期不交易。
strategy.execution_time: 若前 Close 到当日 Open 已越过阈值，按常规时段 Open；否则调整后日内 OHLC 触及阈值时按精确理论阈值；零滑点、零费用、每天最多一笔。
strategy.position_sizing: long-only；每个窗口从 100,000 美元现金开始，每次全仓或全现金，允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.initial_position: 每个窗口独立空仓，等待普通买入信号；绩效从窗口首个交易日开始，包含等待首买期间。

windows.warmup: QQQ inception; no pre-listing history exists
use approved pre-2010 QQQ closes; no pre-window trades

sweeps.label: C · 三短均线快速转弱阈值 (%)
F 中心 · 三短均线中心
F 间距 · 三短均线间隔
H · 长均线再入场 SMA

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: Each window invests 100,000 USD in QQQ at that window's first regular-session Open and holds to the window end; all strategy cases use the identical evaluation dates.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse the accepted v3 interactive controls. Put the parameter-sensitivity curves before the market chart and do not render a per-order table.

research.hypothesis: A structurally useful parameter neighborhood should show locally smooth CAGR and Sharpe curves and broadly similar response directions in two non-overlapping historical periods, rather than a single isolated spike.
research.primary_metric: For every OAT sweep plot absolute CAGR and Sharpe in both windows; record each window's baseline, range, best point, whether the optimum is at a boundary, and cross-window rank-direction correlation without combining objectives.
research.selection_rule: Evaluate the 202 unique combinations implied by 213 sweep points in both windows. Formally verify the baseline and, for every sweep and window, the CAGR maximum and Sharpe maximum after de-duplication.
research.validation_plan: The analysis-start compiled ledger must pass a golden test against the independent pandas ledger. Every selected formal case must match PyBroker and the independent ledger on account state and orders and reproduce its screening metrics within tolerance.
research.promotion_criteria: None. This OAT experiment diagnoses local sensitivity only; a smooth neighborhood may justify a later locked multivariate or walk-forward test.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject if a sweep changes more than one parameter, omits its baseline, case counts differ from 202/213, windows overlap or use unavailable dates, pre-window history trades, any formal first order is not an ordinary buy, daily orders exceed one, or compiled/formal ledgers disagree.
